sentences.zh: 四十分钟听完一本书。

sentences.zh: 狐假虎威，亡羊补牢，画蛇添足，惊弓之鸟，南辕北辙，狡兔三窟，门庭若市。

sentences.pinyin: hú jiǎ hǔ wēi wáng yáng bǔ láo huà shé tiān zú jīng gōng zhī niǎo nán yuán běi zhé jiǎo tù sān kū mén tíng ruò shì

words.en: to intimidate others by borrowing someone else's power
to fix a problem after a loss; better late than never
to spoil something by adding unnecessary details
someone so frightened by a past experience that they startle easily
to act in a way that runs counter to one's goal
a crafty rabbit has three burrows; keep several fallback options
to have a constant stream of visitors
